page.title: Review candidate
page.purpose: Compare candidate outputs with references and acceptance gates before deliberate release or a documented request for changes.

priorities.statement: See actual visual and temporal evidence.
Separate passed checks, human judgment and unknowns.
Accept only the scope that was actually reviewed.

states.description: No operation is pending; identify the current task and available next action.
Work is acknowledged and queued or in flight with observed progress or an honest indeterminate state.
A safe retry is actively reconciling or executing without blind duplicate side effects.
Explain the current task, saved revision and next meaningful action.
Name what is loading; retain stable layout and existing local content.
Acknowledge the requested operation once and prevent duplicate costly submissions.
Distinguish local draft changes from durably saved revision; never claim saved early.
Explain local versus remote state and conflict resolution without silently overwriting edits.
Retain usable content and identify the specific information being refreshed.
Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant low-risk first action.
Show which inputs, output or services are available and which remain incomplete.
Show age, affected decisions and explicit refresh; never silently spend on refresh.
Confirm the concrete durable result and offer inspection or the next task.
Associate actionable correction with each invalid field while preserving input.
Explain the failed operation, preserved work and safe next action with diagnostic reference.
Identify the unavailable operation and authority boundary without requesting unrelated access.
Keep supported local work usable; mark online operations unavailable and never auto-submit paid work on reconnect.
Explain whether retry reuses an operation identity, reconciles prior work or starts a newly authorized operation.
Keep candidate and marked issue evidence visible; new iteration does not overwrite prior review.
List the remaining independent rights, fidelity, motion, portable and worker gates.
Record operator decision, exact artifacts and scoped claims; unresolved limitations remain visible.

claims.statement: Review never collapses source correctness, visual quality, license, temporal behavior and successful decoding into one misleading success badge.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

claims.statement: A release decision binds the inspected candidate version and does not approve later autonomous edits.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

x-design.layout: Large candidate/reference comparison with synchronized views and temporal filmstrip where applicable; issue list, evidence and scoped release decision adjacent.
controls: Compare neutral/beauty/front/side and representative encoded frames
Inspect calibration/mask edges, pill coverage, screen color, aliasing and readable hold
Play/scrub actual final-profile physical motion samples before a long render to inspect joints, support, intersections and silhouette crawl
Inspect source/license, per-viewer/native validation, worker and output-color receipts
Request changes with anchored observations; approve exact candidate/version and scope
details: Automated checks and operator visual acceptance are separate statuses; one cannot impersonate the other.
A photographic after image is appearance evidence, not proof of 3D articulation or environment geometry.
Release lists exact artifact hashes and supported routes; changing geometry/materials/UV or source invalidates affected evidence.
No generated attestation or green check substitutes for missing captures, calibrated masks or human judgment.

x-evidence-policy: No fake selectors, region bindings, setup hooks, captures or attestations. Planned controls are metadata until implemented and grounded.
